verdict.rationale: Ollama exposes a REST API and documented curl/Python/JS clients that could be pointed at a network-accessible host (ollama-gh-4, ollama-docs-9/10/11), implying local network serving is technically possible. However, no evidence explicitly confirms binding to a LAN interface, and a community comment notes the official app lacks any way to connect to a remote Ollama instance, suggesting this capability isn't fully surfaced or documented in the evidence pack.
